# @surfaces-ui/engine

Engine adapter interface for Surfaces UI servers.

The `Engine` interface the server's engine adapters implement.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/engine
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
